name: Instagram Comments Sentiment Tracker - Schedule + Graph API + ChatGPT AI + Sheets + Gmail Digest

parameters.content:
## Instagram Comments Sentiment Tracker

Track what customers say about you on Instagram without reading every comment yourself. Each morning this workflow collects comments from your latest posts, an OpenAI model rates the sentiment of each one, and only the positive comments are saved to Google Sheets. In the evening your team receives one email digest with the day's best customer feedback.

### How it works
1. A **Schedule Trigger** runs daily at 9 AM and loads your settings from the **Config** node.
2. The **Instagram Graph API** returns your last 5 posts and up to 30 comments per post, processed one at a time.
3. An **OpenAI** model classifies each comment as positive, neutral or negative with a confidence score.
4. Only positive comments pass the filter. A **Google Sheets** lookup skips comments that were already saved, so repeat runs never create duplicates.
5. A second trigger at 8 PM reads today's saved comments and sends an HTML digest through **Gmail**.

### Setup steps
1. Add your Instagram Business Account ID and access token in the **Config** node. You need a Business account linked to a Facebook Page with instagram_basic, instagram_manage_comments and pages_read_engagement permissions.
2. Connect your OpenAI credential in the sentiment analysis node.
3. Create a Google Sheet with a tab named Positive Comments and the eight columns used in the Save node, then replace YOUR_INSTAGRAM_TRACKER_SHEET_ID in the three Sheets nodes.
4. Connect Gmail, replace YOUR_TEAM_EMAIL in the digest node, and activate the workflow.

### Customization
Change the post and comment limits in the Config node, move the trigger times, or edit the prompt to track negative comments for complaint monitoring instead.

## 1. Schedule and config
Runs every day at 9 AM. All Instagram settings live in one Config node, so you only edit values here.

## 2. Fetch posts and comments
Gets the last 5 posts, then loops through each post and each comment one at a time.

## 3. AI sentiment filter
An OpenAI model rates every comment. Only positive comments with real text move ahead, the rest return to the loop.

## 4. Check duplicates and save
Looks up the comment ID in the sheet and appends only new positive comments.

## 5. Daily digest email
A separate 8 PM trigger reads today's saved comments and emails a summary to your team.
